2.1.en: Arjuna's crying, overwhelmed, frozen. Krishna sees it all and steps in. Big talk incoming.
2.1.hi: Arjun ro raha hai, overwhelmed hai, freeze ho gaya hai. Krishna sab dekh rahe hain. Ab badi baat hone wali hai.

2.2.en: Krishna: "Bro, why are you breaking down right now? This isn't you, and it won't get you anywhere."
2.2.hi: Krishna: "Is time pe kyun toot rahe ho? Ye tum nahi ho, aur isse kuch nahi milega."

2.3.en: This isn't you. Stop doom-spiralling, get up, and handle it. You're bigger than this moment.
2.3.hi: Ye tum nahi ho. Overthinking band karo, utho, aur handle karo. Tum is moment se bade ho.

2.4.en: Arjuna: "How do I fight people I literally look up to?" Real dilemma, real pain.
2.4.hi: Arjun: "Jinki main izzat karta hoon, unse kaise ladun?" Real dilemma, real dard.

2.5.en: Arjuna would rather be broke than hurt his teachers. Any win built on that feels toxic to him.
2.5.hi: Arjun ko apne gurus ko hurt karne se better bheekh maangna lagta hai. Aisi jeet usko toxic lagti hai.

2.6.en: Arjuna doesn't even know what winning means anymore. Win or lose, someone he loves gets hurt.
2.6.hi: Arjun ko pata hi nahi jeet kya hai. Jeete ya haare, koi apna hi hurt hoga.

2.7.en: Arjuna finally admits: "I'm confused. I need help. Guide me." Asking for help is the first real step.
2.7.hi: Arjun finally maanta hai: "Main confused hoon, guide karo." Help maangna hi pehla real step hai.

2.8.en: Even owning the whole world wouldn't fix this pain. Money and power can't heal a confused mind.
2.8.hi: Poori duniya mil jaaye tab bhi ye dard nahi jaayega. Paisa aur power confused mind ko heal nahi karte.

2.9.en: Arjuna says "I won't fight" and goes silent. Full shutdown mode.
2.9.hi: Arjun bolta hai "Main nahi ladunga" aur chup ho jaata hai. Full shutdown mode.

2.10.en: Krishna smiles. Not mocking, just calm. He knows this crisis is where the growth starts.
2.10.hi: Krishna muskurate hain. Mazaak nahi, bas calm. Unhe pata hai growth yahin se shuru hoti hai.

2.11.en: You're overthinking things that don't deserve your grief. Wise people don't spiral over life or death.
2.11.hi: Jis baat pe dukh nahi hona chahiye, uspe overthink kar rahe ho. Samajhdaar log zindagi-maut pe spiral nahi karte.

2.12.en: You, me, everyone here: we always existed and always will. You're not as temporary as you think.
2.12.hi: Tum, main, sab: hum hamesha the aur hamesha rahenge. Tum utne temporary nahi ho jitna sochte ho.

2.13.en: Childhood, teen years, old age, then a new body. You keep upgrading; the real you stays.
2.13.hi: Bachpan, jawani, budhapa, phir naya body. Tum upgrade hote rehte ho, asli tum wahi rehte ho.

2.14.en: Feelings come and go like weather. One bad day isn't your whole story. Let it pass and keep going.
2.14.hi: Feelings mausam ki tarah aati-jaati hain. Ek bura din poori story nahi. Guzarne do, aage badho.

2.15.en: Stay the same whether it's pain or pleasure. That steady person can't be shaken by anything.
2.15.hi: Dukh ho ya sukh, same raho. Aise insaan ko koi hila nahi sakta.

2.16.en: What's fake never really exists. What's real never disappears. Learn to tell the difference.
2.16.hi: Jo fake hai woh kabhi tikta nahi. Jo real hai woh kabhi jaata nahi. Farak samjho.

2.17.en: The thing that runs through everything can't be destroyed. Nobody can delete the real you.
2.17.hi: Jo sab mein hai, usko koi khatam nahi kar sakta. Asli tumhe koi delete nahi kar sakta.

2.18.en: Bodies have an expiry date. The soul doesn't. So do what you have to do.
2.18.hi: Body ki expiry date hai, aatma ki nahi. Toh jo karna hai woh karo.

2.19.en: Thinking the soul kills or gets killed? Both takes are wrong. It's untouchable.
2.19.hi: Aatma maarti hai ya marti hai? Dono galat. Woh untouchable hai.

2.20.en: The real you was never born and can't die. Bodies change, but the one watching it all stays.
2.20.hi: Asli tum na kabhi paida hue, na maroge. Body badalti hai, par dekhne wala wahi rehta hai.

2.21.en: Once you know the soul can't be destroyed, the whole fear of killing and dying changes.
2.21.hi: Jab samajh aa jaaye ki aatma amar hai, toh maarne-marne ka darr hi badal jaata hai.

2.22.en: Changing bodies is like changing clothes. Old fit off, new fit on. Same you inside.
2.22.hi: Body badalna kapde badalne jaisa hai. Purana outfit off, naya on. Andar wahi tum.

2.23.en: Weapons can't cut it, fire can't burn it, water can't wet it, wind can't dry it. Built different.
2.23.hi: Hathiyar kaat nahi sakte, aag jala nahi sakti, paani bhigo nahi sakta, hawa sukha nahi sakti. Built different.

2.24.en: The soul can't be cut, burned, soaked or dried. It's everywhere, steady, and forever.
2.24.hi: Aatma na kat-ti, na jalti, na bheegti, na sookhti. Har jagah, steady aur hamesha.

2.25.en: You can't see it or fully figure it out, and it never changes. So stop grieving.
2.25.hi: Na dikhti hai, na poori samajh aati hai, na badalti hai. Toh dukh band karo.

2.26.en: Even if you think the soul dies every time, grieving still doesn't help. Stay strong.
2.26.hi: Agar maano ki aatma baar-baar marti hai, tab bhi rona kaam nahi aata. Strong raho.

2.27.en: Whoever's born will die, and whoever dies comes back. Don't stress over what can't be avoided.
2.27.hi: Jo paida hua woh jaayega, jo gaya woh lautega. Jo tal nahi sakta uski tension kyun?

2.28.en: We come from the unknown and go back to it. We only see the middle part. Why panic?
2.28.hi: Unknown se aaye, unknown mein jaayenge. Hum sirf beech ka part dekhte hain. Panic kyun?

2.29.en: Some see the soul as a miracle, some talk about it, some hear about it. Few actually get it.
2.29.hi: Koi aatma ko miracle maanta hai, koi baat karta hai, koi sunta hai. Samajhte bahut kam hain.

2.30.en: The soul in every body is eternal. Nobody is ever truly lost. Don't drown in grief.
2.30.hi: Har body ki aatma amar hai. Koi sach mein khota nahi. Dukh mein mat doobo.

2.31.en: This is literally your role. Backing out of the right fight doesn't suit you.
2.31.hi: Ye tumhara role hai. Sahi ladai se peeche hatna tumhe suit nahi karta.

2.32.en: A real chance to stand up for what's right is rare. Lucky are those who get one.
2.32.hi: Sahi cheez ke liye khade hone ka mauka rare hai. Lucky hain jinhe milta hai.

2.33.en: Skip this fight and you lose your purpose, your respect, and your peace.
2.33.hi: Ye ladai chhodi toh purpose, respect aur sukoon, teeno jaayenge.

2.34.en: Run away and people will talk about it forever. For someone respected, that hurts more than anything.
2.34.hi: Bhaage toh log hamesha baat karenge. Respected insaan ke liye ye sabse zyada chubhta hai.

2.35.en: The legends will think you got scared. The ones who hyped you up will lose respect.
2.35.hi: Legends sochenge tum darr gaye. Jo tumhe hype karte the, woh respect kho denge.

2.36.en: Haters will roast you nonstop. What's more painful than that?
2.36.hi: Haters nonstop roast karenge. Isse zyada dard kya hoga?

2.37.en: Lose and you still win something. Win and you get it all. So get up and fight.
2.37.hi: Haaro toh bhi kuch milega, jeeto toh sab kuch. Toh utho aur lado.

2.38.en: Pleasure or pain, gain or loss, win or fail: treat them the same and just do your duty.
2.38.hi: Sukh-dukh, fayda-nuksaan, jeet-haar: sabko same dekho aur apna kaam karo.

2.39.en: Theory done. Now the practical: how to work without getting trapped by your actions.
2.39.hi: Theory ho gayi. Ab practical: kaam karo bina usme phanse.

2.40.en: On this path no effort is ever wasted. Even a little practice protects you from big fears.
2.40.hi: Is raaste pe koi effort waste nahi hota. Thodi si practice bhi bade darr se bachati hai.

2.41.en: Focused mind = one clear goal. Scattered mind = a hundred tabs open and nothing done.
2.41.hi: Focused mind = ek clear goal. Scattered mind = sau tabs khule, kaam zero.

2.42.en: Some people use religion just to chase rewards and luxury. That noise kills real focus.
2.42.hi: Kuch log dharm ko sirf rewards aur luxury ke liye use karte hain. Woh noise focus khatam karta hai.

2.43.en: Chasing heaven, perks and power as the goal? Your mind stays scattered and never settles.
2.43.hi: Swarg, perks aur power ko hi goal banaoge toh mind kabhi settle nahi hoga.

2.44.en: Hooked on pleasure and power? You'll never build the deep focus that actually matters.
2.44.hi: Pleasure aur power ke addict ho? Toh asli deep focus kabhi nahi banega.

2.45.en: Rise above the push and pull of moods. Stop obsessing over getting and keeping stuff. Stay centered.
2.45.hi: Moods ke push-pull se upar utho. Cheezein paane aur bachane ki tension chhodo. Centered raho.

2.46.en: When you've found the ocean, you don't need the well. Real wisdom covers everything the rituals promise.
2.46.hi: Samundar mil gaya toh kuan kya karna? Asli gyaan mein sab rituals ka fayda aa jaata hai.

2.47.en: You control the effort, not the outcome. Grades, likes, promotions aren't your department. Do the work, drop the result anxiety.
2.47.hi: Effort tumhare haath mein hai, result nahi. Marks, likes, promotion tumhara department nahi. Kaam karo, result ki tension chhodo.

2.48.en: Do your thing with a steady mind. Win or lose, stay balanced. That calm focus is real yoga.
2.48.hi: Apna kaam steady mind se karo. Jeet ho ya haar, balance mat khona. Yahi asli yoga hai.

2.49.en: Working only for rewards keeps you stressed. Working with a calm mind keeps you free.
2.49.hi: Sirf reward ke liye kaam karoge toh stress rahega. Calm mind se karoge toh free rahoge.

2.50.en: A balanced mind is the real skill. Yoga is basically being great at what you do, without stress.
2.50.hi: Balanced mind hi asli skill hai. Yoga matlab apne kaam mein best hona, bina stress ke.

2.51.en: Wise people work hard but don't cling to the results. That's how they escape the endless cycle.
2.51.hi: Samajhdaar log mehnat karte hain par result se chipakte nahi. Isliye cycle se nikal jaate hain.

2.52.en: Once you see through the confusion, all the hype and noise around you stops mattering.
2.52.hi: Jab confusion clear ho jaata hai, toh aas-paas ka hype aur noise matter nahi karta.

2.53.en: When your mind stops getting pulled around by every opinion and stays steady, that's the real breakthrough.
2.53.hi: Jab har opinion se mind idhar-udhar nahi bhaagta aur steady rehta hai, wahi asli breakthrough hai.

2.54.en: Arjuna asks: "What does a truly steady person look like? How do they talk, sit, move?"
2.54.hi: Arjun poochta hai: "Sach mein steady insaan kaisa hota hai? Kaise bolta, baithta, chalta hai?"

2.55.en: When you stop needing outside stuff to be happy and feel complete inside, you're truly steady.
2.55.hi: Jab khush rehne ke liye bahar ki cheezein nahi chahiye aur andar se complete feel karo, tab tum steady ho.

2.56.en: Not shaken by pain, not chasing pleasure, free from fear and anger. That's peak calm.
2.56.hi: Dukh se hilta nahi, sukh ke peeche bhaagta nahi, darr aur gusse se free. Peak calm.

2.57.en: Good news or bad news, they don't overreact either way. That's real stability.
2.57.hi: Achhi news ho ya buri, overreact nahi karta. Yahi asli stability hai.

2.58.en: Like a tortoise pulling in its limbs, pull your senses back from distractions. That's focus.
2.58.hi: Kachhua jaise apne pair andar kheench leta hai, waise senses ko distractions se wapas kheencho. Yahi focus hai.

2.59.en: You can avoid temptations, but the craving stays. It only fades when you find something higher.
2.59.hi: Temptation se door reh sakte ho, par craving rehti hai. Woh tab jaati hai jab kuch bada mil jaaye.

2.60.en: Your senses are strong enough to drag even a smart person off track. Stay alert.
2.60.hi: Senses itne strong hain ki smart insaan ko bhi track se hata dein. Alert raho.

2.61.en: Control your senses and stay focused on the Divine. That's where steady wisdom comes from.
2.61.hi: Senses control karo aur Bhagwan pe focus rakho. Steady gyaan wahin se aata hai.

2.62.en: Keep thinking about something and you get attached. Attachment becomes wanting. Blocked wanting becomes anger. Sound familiar?
2.62.hi: Kisi cheez ke baare mein baar-baar socho toh attachment hota hai, phir chahat, phir gussa. Relatable?

2.63.en: Anger fogs your head, you forget who you are, you make choices you regret. Catch the spiral early.
2.63.hi: Gusse mein dimaag dhundhla, tum bhool jaate ho tum kaun ho, phir galat decisions. Spiral jaldi pakdo.

2.64.en: Enjoy the world without love-hate drama and with your senses in check. That's how you find peace.
2.64.hi: Duniya enjoy karo bina love-hate drama ke, senses control mein rakho. Wahi peace hai.

2.65.en: With a peaceful mind all sadness fades, and your thinking gets clear fast.
2.65.hi: Peaceful mind mein saara dukh khatam ho jaata hai aur soch jaldi clear hoti hai.

2.66.en: No focus, no peace. No peace, no real happiness. It all starts with a steady mind.
2.66.hi: Focus nahi toh peace nahi. Peace nahi toh asli khushi nahi. Sab steady mind se shuru hota hai.

2.67.en: Let your senses run wild and they'll drag your mind like wind pushing a boat off course.
2.67.hi: Senses ko khula chhodo toh woh mind ko aise le jaate hain jaise hawa naav ko raaste se bhatka de.

2.68.en: When your senses don't control you, your wisdom becomes rock solid.
2.68.hi: Jab senses tumhe control nahi karte, tab tumhara gyaan rock solid ho jaata hai.

2.69.en: What the world hypes, the wise ignore. What the world ignores, the wise see clearly. Different vision.
2.69.hi: Duniya jisko hype karti hai, wise log ignore karte hain. Jo duniya ignore karti hai, woh unhe saaf dikhta hai.

2.70.en: Rivers keep flowing in, but the ocean stays calm. Let desires come and go. That's peace.
2.70.hi: Nadiyaan girti rehti hain, par samundar calm rehta hai. Desires aane-jaane do. Yahi peace hai.

2.71.en: Drop the cravings, the ego and the "mine, mine, mine" mindset. That's when you find real peace.
2.71.hi: Cravings, ego aur "mera, mera" wali soch chhodo. Tabhi asli sukoon milta hai.

2.72.en: This is the ultimate state: total clarity and calm. Reach it, even at the very end, and you're free.
2.72.hi: Ye ultimate state hai: total clarity aur calm. Aakhri pal mein bhi mil jaaye toh tum free ho.
